scope_authority.M4_5_PRIMARY_OBJECTIVE: Define and freeze the executor-neutral Portable Plan Mutation Port, multi-domain precondition model (Subject CAS vs external authority CAS vs semantic normalized digest), and durable mutation journal contract that together establish the mechanical external mutation and recovery boundary without implementing the GitHub-specific adapter or durable recovery execution.

ownership_distinction.evidence: M4-5 owns journal contract (states, write order, fields, precedence, crash windows J1-J10, reconciliation precedence, downstream interface); M4-7 owns durable persistence and reconciliation execution per m4-5-scope-and-ownership.json and m4-5-downstream-m4-6-m4-7-contract.json

raw_authority.capture_timing: after validate Subject precondition and after read external authority, before PREPARED

cross_authority.mechanical_boundary: Subject Graph mutation committed in own DB transaction; external Portable Plan authority effect is separate optimistic attempt guarded by durable PREPARED/APPLYING + read-before-write + verify-after-write + reconciliation; no distributed transaction

transitions: PREPARED->FAILED_NO_EFFECT (durability fails before external attempt J1/J9)

required_write_order: perform at most one external mutation attempt
read authority store after mutation where result permits

at_most_one.semantics: One journal record owns at most one external attempt (APPLYING->at most one call); duplicate executors reservation-gated via ownership/lease; recovery takeover reads stranded APPLYING before any new attempt; does not require M4-5 to implement distributed persistence — contract only, durable enforcement is M4-7

sequence: read current raw authority via PlanAuthorityReadAdapter
verify expected authority revision/digest against authorized precondition (raw_source_revision+observed_raw_digest)
compare to authorized precondition stored in PREPARED
only if exactly equal proceed to external apply; otherwise STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed

verify_after_write.mandatory: re-read authoritative raw source after mutation where result permits and classify observed state; HTTP 2xx / exit 0 insufficient

inputs.OBSERVED: fresh raw authority read after uncertain outcome

classification.OBSERVED==CANDIDATE: VERIFIED_RECOVERED (intended effect present, no duplicate write)
classification.OBSERVED==ORIGINAL: RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT only after fresh authorization+Subject+raw preconditions re-established; else remain RECONCILING

three_way.normalized_rule: normalized equality supporting evidence only; raw candidate identity required for VERIFIED_RECOVERED; normalized equals candidate but raw differs -> CONFLICT per J8

semantic_rollback.evidence: Recovery differs from rollback; reconciled CONFLICT/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN never authorizes compensating semantic mutation

unknown_outcome.semantics: external effect cannot yet be deterministically classified; not automatic failure, not automatic success, not permission to retry immediately; mandatory RECONCILING read before any new attempt

retry_authorization.rule: observed original/no-effect after reconciliation may become RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT only when exact accepted rules satisfied: fresh semantic authorization + Subject precondition + raw authority precondition + new bounded lease/attempt; old lease never automatically authorizes next attempt
retry_authorization.evidence: m4-5-reconciliation-plan.json RETRYABLE classification + m4-5-journal-state-machine.json RECONCILING->RETRYABLE transition

idempotency_linkage.m4_3_identity: operation+target+idempotency_key+intent_fingerprint+authorization fingerprint (principal, contract_hash, Subject+raw preconditions, approval/Decision basis, expiry, mutation_scope)
idempotency_linkage.linkage: M4-3 SubjectTransaction idempotency lookup reused and extended with external preconditions/candidate digest; same key + changed authorization = CONFLICT, never replay

opaque_identifiers.evidence: journal_may_not_invent excludes user intent/Project choice/Subject choice/successor/Decision/Approval; journal_is_not_semantic_authority invariant

parallel_contract.policy: Port contract defined in M4-5; downstream M4-6 and M4-7 may read it but not concurrently write same hot file during implementation; shared hot files remain integration_only for downstream; conditional_parallel with serialization/integration_only

windows.J1: durability fails before external attempt (PREPARED without APPLYING -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT)
windows.J2: authority definitively rejects with proven no effect (APPLYING -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT)
windows.J5: observed==original -> RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT only with fresh auth
windows.J8: normalized equals candidate but raw differs -> CONFLICT
windows.J9: PREPARED persistence fails before APPLYING (FAILED_NO_EFFECT, no attempt)
windows.J10: nonterminal after terminal persistence failure -> RECONCILING (future run reads authority)

crash_windows.coverage: All 10 windows have durable_state + external effect + restart classification + allowed next action + fresh auth / semantic choice flag per m4-5-reconciliation-plan.json C1-C9 + m4-5-journal-state-machine.json J1-J10 transitions + m4-5-failure-injection-plan.json hooks

failure_injection.mechanism: FakePlanAuthorityAdapter + fixture authority (disposable raw bodies with deterministic revisions/digests) + disposable local store + controllable fault-injection adapter; no production GitHub writes
failure_injection.determinism: All faults deterministically triggered via fake adapter hooks and fixture revision/digest control; no random network dependence

duplicate_executor.semantics: same semantic identity / same journal record -> replay (REPLAYED_VERIFIED, no duplicate effect); different semantic identity using same user idempotency key (changed authorization semantics / intent) -> CONFLICT, not replay
duplicate_executor.duplicate_eligibility: reservation/lease enforces single external apply eligibility; winner moves PREPARED->APPLYING; loser sees APPLYING taken and must not issue second external write; recovery takeover reads stranded APPLYING if winner crashes

slices.objective: Freeze Portable Plan Mutation Port interface and multi-domain revision/digest model (contract-only, no durable persistence yet)
Freeze durable mutation journal contract (states, write order, journal fields, invariants - no DB execution yet)
Freeze external apply + verify-after-write contracts via generic Port (no GitHub implementation)
Freeze three-way reconciliation and retry authorization contracts
Wire idempotency linkage and canonical result reuse; freeze platform-neutrality and downstream contracts
Materialize deterministic failure injection harness and M4-5-owned regression closure (fake adapter + fixture authority + disposable store)

cases.REC-02: observed original -> RETRYABLE only with fresh auth
